Who We Are

We work like a partner,
not a vendor.

Capybara Creative House was born from a simple belief: great creative work shouldn't feel heavy.

Our name comes from the capybara — the most chill animal on earth, yet somehow everyone loves it. That's how we work: calm on the surface, serious about the results.

It's a monthly retainer. We plan, create, and deliver your content on an agreed schedule, with a set number of posts, reels, and revisions each month. You always know what's coming.
We usually work in 3-month cycles so the strategy has room to show results — but we're flexible for one-off projects too.
Two rounds per deliverable, so we stay sharp and on schedule. Extra rounds can always be arranged.
A dedicated team from Capyhouse — not freelancers passed around. You'll know exactly who's handling your work.
Yes. Most of our work happens remotely, and we travel for shoots and events when needed.
